And for those of us who can successfully embrace that, I'd say the future is golden.|Sebastian to [[Cooper Howard]]}} '''Sebastian Leslie''' is an actor from the pre-[[Great War|War]] era {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== By the 2070s, Sebastian Leslie had made a name for himself as an actor in [[Hollywood]], where he played a character named Bartholomew Codsworth. He also became acquainted with, and later counted as a friend by, [[The Ghoul|Cooper Howard]]. Sebastian would eventually sell the rights to use his voice to [[General Atomics International]], who incorporated it into their [[Mister Handy (TV series)|Mister Handy]] line of robots, paying him [[Pre-War money|$]]186,000 (pre-tax). His agent managed to negotiate the inclusion of a personal Mister Handy for Sebastian. However, he later expressed to Cooper that it felt awkward to hear his own voice speaking as a servant in his home.{{FOTV|1|6}} ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Trap]]=== Sebastian attended a social event hosted by [[Barb Howard]] at the house owned by her and Cooper, where he briefly entertained two [[female server]]s with a story about his role as Bartholemew Codsworth before Cooper came to him. The two actors commented on their prospects, where Leslie advised Howard about his friend's misgivings with his wife, encouraging him to partner with the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] and give up on acting. ==Personality== Sebastian outwardly reflects the jovial and personable demeanor seen in the Mister Handy robots he contributed to. However, when speaking personally to friends like Cooper, he admits to feeling strangled by the industry of acting and promotes his belief that the future is in "products" such as Vault-Tec's [[Vault]]s. ==Appearances== Sebastian Leslie appears only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|6=106}} ==Gallery== FOTV s1 ep6 Sebastian Leslie 2.png|Sebastian laughs seeing Cooper FOTV s1 ep6 Sebastian Leslie 3.png|Sebastian and Cooper talk business ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Pre-War actors]] [[ru:Себастьян Лесли]]
